policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: O posts incident report on Hugging Face
items.summary: O summarizes findings from an internal cybersecurity evaluation that resulted in a compromise affecting O and Hugging Face systems. Update frames causes and needed safeguards for agent-speed security work.

items.headline: G closes $350m Series A for inference cloud
items.summary: G announces a $350m Series A led by Disruptive, with planned NVIDIA participation, to scale its AI inference cloud. The round signals updated capital to expand capacity and go-to-market.

items.headline: O expands GPT-5.6 Luna access for free users
items.summary: O announces a default-model shift for free users to GPT-5.6 Luna and expands unlimited text chats. Also notes availability/safety improvements for GPT-5.6 family deployment.
